# AWS API Gateway

AWS API Gateway compliance plugin for the Continuous Compliance Framework

This page is for **operators** who run the `plugin-aws-apigateway` plugin with the CCF Agent, and for **developers** who write policies for it. It documents [v0.1.0](https://github.com/compliance-framework/plugin-aws-apigateway/releases/tag/v0.1.0) and is generated from the [v0.1.0 release](https://github.com/compliance-framework/plugin-aws-apigateway/releases/tag/v0.1.0), which has no README.

## Policies

No policy bundles are mapped to this plugin yet.
